title: A prayer for wealth and children

verses.t: May the Ordainer give us wealth, Lord, ruler of the world of life: with full hand may he give to us.
May Dhātar grant the worshipper henceforth imperishable life. May we obtain the favour of the God who giveth every boon.
To him may Dhātar grant all kinds of blessings who, craving children, serves him in his dwelling. Him may the Gods invest with life eternal, yea, all the Gods and Aditi accordant.
May this our gift please Savitar, Rāti, Dhātar, Prajāpati, and Agni Lord of Treasures. May Tvashtar, Vishnu, blessing him with children, give store ot riches to the sacrificer.
